'''Feral Vampyres''' are a type of [[vampyre]] that can be found in the [[Haunted Woods]], near the [[Abandoned Mine]], and in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] (Zamorak aligned). They are aggressive, and will attack anyone. They are stronger than other vampyres like [[juvenile]]s and most [[juvinate]]s, but can be harmed by all [[weapons]]. Feral vampyres always drop [[vampyre dust]]. Having [[garlic]] in your inventory does '''not''' weaken feral vampyres.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1106580691045810176|date=15 March 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109480|archivedate=28 May 2020}}

The feral vampyres found in the Haunted Woods and Abandoned Mine will occasionally bite players, which can sometimes drain stats and will cause the vampyre to recover a small amount of [[hitpoints]]. Additionally, the [[Spider (Morytania)|spiders]] in the Haunted Woods will follow players and summon level 72 feral vampyres to attack them.

If the player is wearing a [[holy symbol]] whilst being attacked by a Feral Vampyre, occasionally the vampyre will be debuffed, reducing their Attack, Strength, Defence, and Magic by 25%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/650998169736753152|date=5 October 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98468|archivedate=13 May 2023|quote=It reduces the vampire's strength, attack, defence and magic by 25%.}} This is indicated by the chatbox message {{mes|The vampyre is weakened by your holy symbol of Saradomin.}} However, this debuff quickly expires. 

Additionally, held [[vampyre juvenile]]s and [[vampyre juvinate]]s may sometimes be turned into level 64 feral vampyres when a [[guthix balance]] potion is used on them. These feral vampyres do not bite players to heal themselves, and have no drops besides vampyre dust.

==Trivia==
*They appear to have the same facial features as [[Ghast]]s found the Mort Myre Swamp.
*If a player has entered [[Morytania]] without completing the [[Priest in Peril]] quest, there is a chance that an [[Feral Vampyre (NPC)|unattackable Feral Vampyre]] will spawn and attack the player, causing the player to be teleported back outside of Morytania in front of the [[Paterdomus|Temple of Saradomin]].
